diagnosis.root_cause: A billing-api deploy combined a database migration renaming the invoices.amount column to amount_cents with code changes, causing old instances to fail with SQLSTATE 42703 column does not exist errors during invoice-creation requests.
evidence: 2026-11-17T22:00:00Z  billing-api  a7b8c9d  rename invoices.amount -> amount_cents (migration + code in one release)
2026-11-17T22:01:00Z  billing-api  ERROR  old instances: column invoices.amount does not exist (SQLSTATE 42703); invoice writes failing
diagnosis.recommended_fix: Pause or rollback the billing-api deployment to align code versions with the correct database schema, and decouple database migrations from application code releases in future deployments.
